pages: Wren Terei, a woman of forty-four, salt and pepper hair in a low bun, a teal scrub top over a grey shirt with the sleeves pushed past her elbows, stands at the shelf and lifts the lid of one flat blue case. Middle distance: a couch with a towel over its arm, a steel trolley. Background: corridor window, grey daylight.

Wren Terei, forty-four, salt and pepper hair in a low bun, a teal scrub top over grey sleeves pushed past her elbows, stands alone in the clinic room with one hand resting on the closed blue case on the shelf, her chin slightly lifted. Middle distance: the couch, the trolley. Background: the corridor window, flat morning light.

Wren Terei, forty-four, salt and pepper hair in a low bun, a teal scrub top over grey sleeves pushed past her elbows, holds one green nylon filament in her right hand and presses it gently onto the pad of her own left thumb. Middle distance: the open flat case, a stack of forms. Background: couch, the corridor window, grey daylight.

Wren Terei, forty-four, salt and pepper hair in a low bun, a teal scrub top over grey sleeves pushed past her elbows, writes in a ruled column on the sheet in the lid of one open blue case with a pen. Middle distance: ten plastic filament holders in their slots, a steel trolley. Background: the corridor window, grey daylight.

Wiremu Sola, a man of thirty-one, short black hair, a white chef's jacket with the sleeves rolled and a dark blue apron, stands at a stainless steel pass holding one white dinner plate with his right thumb pressed under its rim. Middle distance: a heat lamp, a rack of trays. Background: a kitchen wall of steel, hot amber light.

Wren Terei, forty-four, salt and pepper hair in a low bun, a teal scrub top over grey sleeves pushed past her elbows, draws with one pencil on a sheet of paper printed with an outline of a hand. Middle distance: the open blue case on the trolley, a steel ruler. Background: the couch, the corridor window, grey daylight.

Wren Terei, forty-four, salt and pepper hair in a low bun, a teal scrub top over grey sleeves pushed past her elbows, writes a single figure in one box on a printed form lying on the steel trolley, her wrist resting on the paper. Middle distance: a pen, the open blue case. Background: the couch, the corridor window, grey daylight.

Wren Terei, forty-four, salt and pepper hair in a low bun, a teal scrub top over grey sleeves pushed past her elbows, stands with her eyes shut, counting on the fingers of one hand, the other hand flat on the open blue case. Middle distance: a hand outline sheet, the steel trolley. Background: the clinic room wall, grey daylight.

Wren Terei, forty-four, salt and pepper hair in a low bun, a teal scrub top over grey sleeves pushed past her elbows, drops one small blue filament holder into a lidded bin beside the trolley. Middle distance: the open case, a second sealed holder. Background: the couch, the corridor window, grey daylight.

Wren Terei, forty-four, salt and pepper hair in a low bun, a teal scrub top over grey sleeves pushed past her elbows, holds her left hand up before her face and presses one fingertip onto the pad of her own thumb. Middle distance: the open blue case, the trolley. Background: the couch, the corridor window, grey daylight.

Wren Terei, forty-four, salt and pepper hair in a low bun, a teal scrub top over grey sleeves pushed past her elbows, lays two fingertips flat along the skin at the edge of her own thumbnail, measuring between two points. Middle distance: the hand outline sheet, a pencil. Background: the open blue case, grey daylight.

Wren Terei, forty-four, salt and pepper hair in a low bun, a teal scrub top over grey sleeves pushed past her elbows, rules a narrow extra column down the edge of a hand outline sheet with one pencil, tilting her head. Middle distance: the open case, the steel trolley. Background: the couch, the corridor window, grey daylight.

Wiremu Sola, thirty-one, short black hair, a white chef's jacket with the sleeves rolled and a dark blue apron, takes one hot metal tray out of a combi oven and grips its rim with his bare right thumb, face turned away. Middle distance: a steel shelf, a folded towel. Background: a hot amber heat lamp, tiled kitchen wall.

Wiremu Sola, thirty-one, short black hair, a white chef's jacket with the sleeves rolled and a dark blue apron, pulls one grey cut-resistant glove off his right hand at the walk-in fridge and stares at the white blistered patch on his thumb pad. Middle distance: the open fridge door, a ticket roll. Background: stainless steel, cold white light.

Wiremu Sola, thirty-one, short black hair, a white chef's jacket with the sleeves rolled and a dark blue apron, sits turning his right forearm over to look at one pale graft donor patch, the edge of a dressing lifting. Middle distance: a plastic chair, a folded towel. Background: a pale hospital wall, flat window light.

Wren Terei, forty-four, salt and pepper hair in a low bun, a teal scrub top over grey sleeves pushed past her elbows, sets one thick yellow filament holder on the open case and marks the sheet beside it with a pencil. Middle distance: a steel ruler, a stack of forms. Background: the couch, the corridor window, grey daylight.

Wren Terei, forty-four, salt and pepper hair in a low bun, a teal scrub top over grey sleeves pushed past her elbows, sits by the couch turning one white card over slowly between her fingers, a pencil laid beside her knee. Middle distance: a folded towel, the steel trolley. Background: the corridor window, grey daylight.

Wren Terei, forty-four, salt and pepper hair in a low bun, a teal scrub top over grey sleeves pushed past her elbows, writes a time in the top box of a form with a pen, one sealed blue filament holder lying beside her hand. Middle distance: the open case, the steel trolley. Background: the couch, the corridor window, grey daylight.

Wren Terei, forty-four, salt and pepper hair in a low bun, a teal scrub top over grey sleeves pushed past her elbows, slides one grey sheet into a plastic box on a store-room shelf, her palm pressing it flat on top. Middle distance: a cardboard file, a stack of boxes. Background: a narrow store room, a strip light.

Wren Terei, forty-four, salt and pepper hair in a low bun, a teal scrub top over grey sleeves pushed past her elbows, puts one grey hand-mapping sheet into a card file on the clinic room shelf and squares the folder with her palm. Middle distance: the steel trolley, a rubber band. Background: the couch, the corridor window, late afternoon light.
